item.title: Trump suggests temporarily withdrawing Blanche's AG nomination over GOP opposition
item.description: Senator John Cornyn continues to block Todd Blanche's confirmation as attorney general, citing new concerns on Thursday.

item.title: Former Goldman Sachs lawyer tells House panel Epstein generated millions for firm
item.description: Ex-Goldman Sachs lawyer Kathy Ruemmler testified that Jeffrey Epstein brought in millions of dollars for the firm, according to a transcript.

item.title: Mortgage rates reach highest level in a year amid inflation concerns
item.description: Mortgage rates are rising as the Fed's rate decision and Middle East conflict fuel inflation worries.

item.title: George and Amal Clooney evacuate French home amid wildfires, send note to mayor
item.description: The couple left their home in southeastern France due to wildfires burning through the region.
